entry_points.text: Late HPET init retries enable on forced address then reserves timers and registers hotplug handlers. VM86 interrupt records pending edge, signals owner and suspends line, ignoring duplicates and ownerless lines. Debug notifier delegates debug events to dispatcher verdict.
Early and full trap setup populate IDT from constant tables and load descriptor; PIC init conditionally registers syscore. Selftest entry lacks landing marker to exercise protection fault path.

exports.text: HPET callback registration fails when disabled and fails busy when occupied, otherwise stores handler and reports success; unregistration clears handler and flags when enabled.
Perf breakpoint read accepts argument and returns without effect; global clock event pointer publishes active PIT event device.

RTC emulation timer start, flag mask and set, alarm store and periodic rate report active versus disabled. Start derives default interval, programs comparator ahead and enables one-shot mode; mask stops empty channel, set starts empty-to-nonempty; slow rates use divisor.

hazards.text: NMI HPET path must avoid taking owned lock; torn cache store corrupts snapshots so atomic discipline and release-as-progress matter. Rearm must catch up if counter overtakes comparator, accounting missed ticks. Breakpoints overlapping entry, percpu, descriptor, task or debug state risk faults and must be rejected.

Masked legacy interrupts can still appear so cached-masked needs in-service verify with once-per-line warning and count plus specific EOIs. Unused PIT wastes VM time and multiprocessor PIT clocksource risks lock contention. Writable discoverable IDT leaks location and allows writes so fixed read-only mapping used.

invariants.text: Direct HPET reader samples hardware on every call without caching. Config sanity needs non all-ones within bounded polls, liveness needs tick change after restart, else abandoned. Sleep damage only on Intel monitor-wait parts with advertised extensions and permitted deepest state, suppressible by force override.
Ahead test treats unsigned difference as signed to handle wrap. Disabling RTC channel clears only enable bit.

Breakpoint control places length-type field and global enable per slot with slowdown bit. Length accepts 1/2/4/8, execute needs undefined length, write and access map then need valid length. Construction rejects overflow and forbidden overlap, range mode needs aligned power-of-two plus extension, final parse enforces alignment.

Kernel membership when range reaches user limit without overflow; overlap when intervals intersect. Flush unregisters all slots and zeroes virtual images. Reload programs addresses in order then status pattern before control. Dispatcher skips clear slots, defers execute during step, clears handled bits, delivers perf, sets resume, and requests more work only if virtual or residual causes remain.

DMA resume resets controllers, programs zero address with count one on eight channels and enables cascade. Registration refused if page port reads all-ones or recent firmware reports no PNP BIOS devices.
Cached 8259 mask uses set-means-masked with master/slave ports by range. IRQ adoption disables line, clears IO APIC bit, installs XT chip with level handling, reenables and assigns legacy vector.

Trigger save preserves masked bits, restore writes both bytes, suspend saves, resume reinits then restores, shutdown masks all. Init records auto mode, sets vector bases and cascade wiring, selects EOI mode, waits for settle, restores masks. Probe skips on compat flag else tests mask pattern excluding cascade and falls back to null on mismatch.

Second stack gate variant selects numbered host stack. Early table covers debug/breakpoint plus page fault or virtualization; full table adds faults with stack switching and user overflow; APIC vectors conditional on features.

External helpers for warnings, barriers, IRQ flags, percpu access, lockdep checks, debug address masks, division, perf counters, CPU features, descriptors, HPET config and MSR access are owned elsewhere and cited only.

locks.text: HPET cached copy updated only while holding spin with interrupts masked via nontearing store then release; joint word observed atomically and contended readers only poll.
8259 mask, unmask, pending checks and global mask/restore run under 8259 spin with interrupts saved, selecting master or slave ports by IRQ range.

state_machines.text: HPET bringup screens capability and sleep damage, maps address, validates config liveness and period, learns channels with RTC minimum, sanitizes boot copies, publishes time source and legacy roles, cleaning up on failure and reporting legacy setup. RTC interrupt always claims and reports conditions via callback.

Breakpoint install finds free slot, records owner, programs address, merges control with ordering before hardware update plus mask; removal clears slot and updates hardware before publishing copy. Both run with local interrupts disabled on local CPU.

PIT use required without timestamp counter else per APIC need, leading to disabled terminal or enabled published event. Compat vector selects emulation or 32-bit entry. Separate page-fault-only table serves early faults.

structs.text: HPET lock cell shares eight bytes as spin plus cached counter or single word on its own cache line starting released. RTC state keeps flags, previous second, alarm time, tick accumulator, last comparator, intervals, divisor and single callback slot.
Each CPU keeps debug control copy mirroring hardware, address copies and initially empty occupant slots sized by breakpoint count.

DMA and 8259 each pair constant ops table with syscore node. XT chip maps mask/disable, unmask and acknowledge with auto-mode variant. Legacy PIC table carries count, chip and callbacks with null zero-IRQ fallback and default 8259 wiring.

ABI facts: HPET name hpet rating 250 mask HPET_MASK flags continuous plus calibrated with guarded reader and resume hooks; RTC freq 64 shift 6 count 1; privilege 0/3 stack 0; IDT limit size-minus-one; trigger two bytes; fault workaround index 6.
Gate specs carry vector, stack, type, privilege, handler and segment with present forced and kernel segment; task gates encode selector.
